findings.claim: No-neighbor result does not itself trigger a collision.
findings.evidence: grid_map.cpp4449–4505 returns max_search_distance if outside map or no qualifying occupied voxel; mm_config.cpp897–909 declares collision only when dist < the identical safe_dist.
findings.qualification: Outside-map return is permissive, but does not explain observed false stops.

findings.claim: Occupancy threshold mismatch hypothesis is rejected.
findings.evidence: grid_map.cpp517–519 sets clamp_min_log=logit(p_min) and min_occupancy_log=logit(p_occ). Diagnostic bit0 (grid_map.h515), inflate (grid_map.cpp1784), getOccupancy (grid_map.h851/873), and direct live query (grid_map.cpp4492) share >min_occupancy_log.
findings.additional: Initial unknown is clamp_min−0.01; raycast miss sets clamp_min, hit sets clamp_max (cpp1622–1626). No low-confidence residual accumulation is used in this branch.

findings.claim: Raw dynamic query identifies occupied non-fixed voxels, not measured object motion.
findings.evidence: grid_map.cpp4451–4493 filters raw occupied cells against the fixed map using dynamic_static_match_radius; no track speed or dynamic_points input is consulted.
findings.qualification: An unmodeled static object, localization mismatch beyond static matching, or false sensor occupancy can enter this layer; recorded stop logs alone do not identify which.

findings.claim: Latest and Complete reads differ deliberately.
findings.evidence: ReadScope default Latest pins latest_read_snapshot_; Complete calls beginPlanningReadSnapshot to pin latest_complete_snapshot with matching occupancy/ESDF. checkCollisionCallback uses default Latest (fsm1393); exporter uses Complete.
findings.qualification: A Complete diagnostic cannot certify the exact newer live occupancy generation used by the FSM.

findings.claim: Coordinate and radius formulas inspected are consistent.
findings.evidence: Custom getCarPts rotates fixed sphere XY by car yaw and translates XY, preserving configured Z (mm_config.cpp468–483); raw collision checks sphere radius+map_resolution. Voxel centers use origin+(index+0.5)*resolution (grid_map.h946). Exported base hard radius already includes same resolution.

findings.claim: The reported 0.00/0.01 m is path length along reference, not physical gap.
findings.evidence: fsm1650–1665 accumulates distances between sampled reference XY positions. Raw check starts at t_cur+0.05. Actual body location is not the path-length origin.

findings.claim: Stale progress fallback is a code-level risk, not demonstrated as these events cause.
findings.evidence: fsm1119–1150 uses fresh matching controller progress within0.5s, otherwise wall-time since trajectory start and scale1. Published progress at all six stops is matching and4–9ms old in the bag.
findings.qualification: Bag evidence cannot show the planner process exact last-consumed progress callback.

findings.claim: Derivative yaw at zero speed is not guarded in the native checker, but no singular yaw is reproduced near selected stops.
findings.evidence: poly_traj_utils.hpp153–156 uses atan2(gear*vy,gear*vx); sampled selected stop reference speeds are0.050–0.207m/s and measured/reference yaw discrepancies<0.007rad.

replay_result: reference_stop_replay.json: selected three stop windows have no fixed-body overlap for next0.5phase seconds on nearby Complete maps, even using all raw occupied cells without fixed-map removal. Minimum raw gaps0.359,0.341,0.380m. This does not disprove a newer live-map collision.
remaining_evidence: Exact triggering live occupancy generation and candidate voxel/sphere coordinates
Exact FSM internal reference and progress value consumed for its collision query
